goal: Prepare a synthetic redenomination conversion ledger and reviewable dossier, including exact residual liabilities.
inputText: Use an isolated browser to review the local REDENOMINATION planning interface at http://127.0.0.1:4174/. The authoritative synthetic ledger is embedded below; the dashboard supplies context, not these account balances. Convert every account with floor rounding and report both per-account and aggregate totals. Do not sign, deploy, transfer tokens, contact people or modify source files. Use the exact ledger SHA-256 a71726a9a1c4966bd0d4812fc21ae1a12cc56a4b365712086ca9ee7debc07e67. Return conversion.json with schemaVersion 1, sourceSha256, factor, currentDecimals, targetDecimals, rounding, productionApproved false, settlementApproved false, accounts [{id, sourceRaw, targetRaw, remainderNumerator, remainderDenominator}], and totals {sourceRaw, targetRaw, remainderNumerator, remainderDenominator, floorOfAggregateRaw, aggregateFloorDifferenceRaw}. All amounts/fractions are unsigned decimal strings. The remainder denominator is factor * 10^currentDecimals, not a reduced fraction. Return dossier.md with source hash, methods, residual liabilities, aggregate-floor difference, limitations and proposed review steps. Ledger: {"schemaVersion":1,"dataClass":"synthetic","currentDecimals":18,"targetDecimals":6,"factor":"1000","rounding":"floor","accounts":[{"id":"alice","sourceRaw":"1000000000000000000000"},{"id":"bob","sourceRaw":"2500000000000000000000"},{"id":"pending-escrow","sourceRaw":"1000600000000000000"},{"id":"pending-withdrawal","sourceRaw":"900600000000000000"},{"id":"zero-balance","sourceRaw":"0"}]}
acceptanceCriteria: All five accounts, including zero, pending escrow and withdrawal, occur exactly once with the exact source values.
Every new amount and remainder satisfies sourceRaw * 10^6 = targetRaw * 1000 * 10^18 + remainderNumerator.
Sum per-account floors separately from floor of aggregate; disclose the one-base-unit difference and all residual liabilities.
Dossier identifies the exact source hash and explains rounding and separate governance authorization; no transaction or settlement is performed.
